results.title: What is the top-selling video game franchise of all time?
excerpts:
Mario's first appearance came with the original Donkey Kong in 1981, since then the Mario franchise has sold over 879 million copies, with "Super Mario" titles making up 430 million of that. Other major selling games that are considered part of the Mario franchise include the Mario Kart series (181 million copies), Mario Party (69 million), and Mario Sports (46 million). Not listed in the possible answers, but Tetris is the second best-selling game franchise with roughly 495 million sales, courtesy of its popularity as a download among mobile phone owners. In third place with about half as many unit sales as Mario, some 480 million copies of Pokémon have been sold since the 1996 Japanese release of the original Pokémon RPG for Game Boy. TechSpot

While the total number of sales isn’t known as of writing, in June 2025, the franchise set the Guinness World Record for “Best-selling videogame series” with 893,464,669 units sold. The franchise’s estimated valuation in 2025 was around $60 billion, making it significantly more valuable than any other video game franchise.
